label: T0: Motion and Time
main_themes: chronos as 'number of motion with respect to before and after' (Physics IV)
asymmetric ontological dependency: time depends on motion
the soul-time question: does time require a soul that counts?
before/after structure as foundation for phantasia
key_claims: Time depends on motion (asymmetric dependency), not vice versa
The before/after structure of time is what phantasia internalizes
Without motion there is no time; without time there is no before/after for phantasia to retain
notes: T0 is the pre-condition for all subsequent T-stages. The Physics IV analysis is the ontological foundation that makes the rest of the T-schema possible.
